title: Launch Safeguard Coordination: blocker triage, fallback choreography, and stakeholder comm scripts
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a coordinated launch-safeguard plan covering: 1) rapid blocker identification and triage criteria, 2) a set of deterministic rollback and rollforward patterns (including partial/route-level fallbacks), and 3) stakeholder-facing communication templates for incidents and rollbacks. This ticket ties together PM, SRE, Runtime, Console, and Legal to ensure a single source of truth during the rollout window.
acceptance_criteria: A concise blocker triage matrix (severity, ownership, triage timebox, mitigation path) published to Confluence
Rollback playbook with three patterns: full rollback, model-variant fallback, and route-level throttled degrade; each pattern has step-by-step runbook items and automated scripts where feasible
Pre-approved incident and rollback comm templates for internal (ops), customers, and executive stakeholders, localized for EU customers
A clear escalation ladder and on-call assignment matrix for the first 72 hours after launch
Dry run completed in staging and notes captured with action items assigned
work_items: Draft blocker triage matrix and share with Runtime & SRE for feedback
Define signals and thresholds that map to triage severity (latency P95, error rate, model quality regressions)
Draft rollback patterns and non-blocking fallback options with engineers
Create comm templates (Slack, Email, Status Page, Customer Success scripts)
Coordinate legal review for EU customer messaging and data residency statements
Schedule a cross-functional tabletop dry run and capture gaps
comm_templates:
Customer — Email (CS/PM): 
Subject: Service notice: temporary degradation for {product}
Hi {customer_name},
We observed a degradation impacting {feature}. Our team has activated mitigation steps and is monitoring. You may see increased latency or timeout errors. We expect normal service within {eta}. If this impacts critical workflows, reply to this message and we will prioritize a dedicated update.
— Redwood Trust & SRE
comments: 2026-03-01 Aisha Raman: Created ticket and initial outline. Tagged Runtime, SRE, Console, Legal. Requested triage matrix template from SRE.
2026-03-03 SRE (comment by Priya Shah): Uploaded initial triage matrix draft to Confluence; suggested adding automated detection playbooks using trace spans. Assigned ENG-41234 for automation spike.

2026-03-05 Luca Moreno: Drafted three rollback patterns and circulated to Runtime leads. Trade-off discussion: prefer model-variant fallback when possible to preserve availability; full rollback reserved for data/regression cases.
2026-03-07 Runtime eng (comment by Mateo Ruiz): Flagged that KV cache invalidation is the biggest source of rollback complexity. Proposed adding a preflight KV checksum to staging runbook.
2026-03-08 Legal (comment by Elena Kovács): Reviewed customer-facing templates; requested GDPR wording adjustments and a separate EU customer cadence for in-region status updates.
2026-03-09 PM review (comment by Jordan Lee): Approved comm templates after minor wording tweaks; added an explicit 'no-commit' window for marketing. Next: schedule tabletop for 2026-03-12.
2026-03-11 Luca Moreno: Dry run scheduled. Updated acceptance criteria with dry run completion. Open action: assign ownership for status page updates (candidate: CS Ops).
open_questions: Who owns automated rollforward in the event a rollback fails? (SRE or Runtime?)
Can Runtime add a route-level percent-based traffic split for staged rollback, or do we rely on gateway feature toggles?
Do we need a separate customer credit policy pre-approved for SEV2 regressions?
next_steps: Finalize triage matrix and publish v1 on Confluence by 2026-03-12
Run tabletop on 2026-03-12 with representatives from Runtime, SRE, Console, CS, Legal
Implement KV checksum preflight and add to staging dry run checklist
Assign status page ownership and confirm automation for status updates
